from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            comp = []
            touches_edge = False
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                if y == 0 or x == 0 or y == h-1 or x == w-1:
                    touches_edge = True
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx = y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx] == bg:
                        seen[ny][nx] = True; q.append((ny,nx))
            if not touches_edge:
                ys = [y for y,x in comp]; xs = [x for y,x in comp]
                color = 7 if (max(ys)-min(ys)+1) % 2 else 2
                for y,x in comp: out[y][x] = color
    return out

def blank(h,w,bg): return [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
def frame(g, r0,c0,r1,c1,color,fill=None):
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): g[r][c]=color
            elif fill is not None: g[r][c]=fill
    return g

d1=blank(29,25,9)
frame(d1,12,11,15,14,0); frame(d1,19,17,25,23,1); frame(d1,23,0,25,2,0)
o1=blank(29,25,9)
frame(o1,12,11,15,14,0,2); frame(o1,19,17,25,23,1,7); frame(o1,23,0,25,2,0,7)
# Pair 2: four framed regions.

frame(d2,7,5,9,7,3); frame(d2,11,5,16,10,9); frame(d2,9,13,13,17,6); frame(d2,9,20,14,25,5)
o2=blank(21,27,0)
